home_page__hero_description: SaaSWeave is the operations console for AI-native teams: track product usage, meter every AI request, and bill for it, all in one workspace.
home_page__integrations__description: SaaSWeave connects to the tools you already run, deploys to any major cloud or JavaScript runtime, and ships with Docker templates out of the box.
home_page__cta_description: Connect your product and watch usage, AI cost, and revenue land in one place within minutes.
pricing_page__description: Pick a plan that fits your team today. Every plan starts with a free trial, and you can change plans any time from the console.
pricing_page__faq_a1: Yes, upgrade or downgrade any time from your workspace billing settings. Changes take effect immediately.
pricing_page__faq_q2: Do you offer a free trial?
pricing_page__faq_a2: Every paid plan starts with a free trial when trials are enabled on the platform. No credit card required to start.
pricing_page__faq_q3: What happens if I go over my plan's usage allowance?
pricing_page__faq_a3: You're billed for the overage at the end of the cycle at the rate shown in your workspace billing page. We'll never cut off access mid-cycle.

about__description: SaaSWeave started as a simple question: what would it take to track product usage, meter every AI request, and bill for it, without stitching together five different tools? This console is the answer — one workspace for usage, billing, and the platform controls that keep it running.
